p.src: 1  The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

ja: も、あなたがたを愛しています。
en: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
u.src: 1  The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

p.src: 2  for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

ja: たちのうちにとどまり、
en: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
u.src: 2  for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

p.src: 3  Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

ja: イエス・キリスト から、
たちとともにあります。
en: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
u.src: 3  Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

ja: 1:3 「キリスト」とは「油を注がれた者」という意味である。

p.src: 4  I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

ja: から命じられたとおり
en: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
u.src: 4  I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

p.src: 5  Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

ja: いします。これは新しい戒めではなく、初めからの戒めです。
en: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
u.src: 5  Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

p.src: 6  This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

ja: むことです。あなたがたが
いていた戒めとは、それに従って
en: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
u.src: 6  This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

p.src: 7  For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

ja: たからです。彼らは、イエス・キリストが
en: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
u.src: 7  For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

p.src: 8  Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

ja: たちが成し遂げてきたものを
en: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
u.src: 8  Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

p.src: 9  Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

ja: 道を踏み外し、キリストの
en: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
u.src: 9  Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

p.src: 10  If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

ja: もし、この教えを携えずにあなたがたのところへ
え入れてはなりません。また、その人にあいさつをしてもなりません。
en: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
u.src: 10  If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

p.src: 11  for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

ja: わることになるからです。
en: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
u.src: 11  for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

p.src: 12  Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

ja: きたいことはたくさんありますが、
とインクで書こうとは思いません。あなたがたのところへ
いたいと願っています。そうすれば、
en: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.
u.src: 12  Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

p.src: 13  The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.

ja: どもたちが、あなたによろしくと伝えています。アーメン。
en: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
u.src: 13  The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
